cards.title: Tidepool Lab Final Shell
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable cause-and-effect card for naming the final result after a pretend tidepool lab change in a paper-only reading nook: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, set a paper bookmark beside the lamp glow, and point to the last blank as the final result space: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Read the invented cause, then write what finally changes on the pretend page: ____________________.
cards.causePrompt: Cause: The tidepool lab crew moves the shell marker from the gray tray to ____________________.
cards.effectPrompt: Effect: The direct change on the pretend page is ____________________.
cards.becausePrompt: Because the shell marker changes places, the lab note now says ____________________.
cards.soPrompt: So the final result at the cushion corner is ____________________.
cards.chainPrompt: Chain: shell marker moves, label changes, final result becomes ____________________.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Look back: Does your final result answer what changed after the first cause: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Circle the cause and write only the final result in the blank: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-away line: On another paper slip, write one cause and its final result: ____________________.

cards.title: Revision River Because Ferry
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable cause-and-effect card for building a because statement on a fictional ferry page in the reading nook: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, draw two paper ferry docks, and choose one plain pretend sentence to improve: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write a because statement that explains why the ferry sentence changes before it lands: ____________________.
cards.causePrompt: Cause: The Revision River ferry finds a foggy detail beside ____________________.
cards.effectPrompt: Effect: The sentence becomes clearer when ____________________.
cards.becausePrompt: Because the ferry swaps the foggy detail for a sharper one, ____________________.
cards.soPrompt: So the far-dock sentence now helps the reader picture ____________________.
cards.chainPrompt: Chain: foggy detail appears, ferry pauses, clearer detail arrives because ____________________.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Look back: Does your because statement connect one cause to one clear effect: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Write only the words after because, then read the full sentence softly: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-away line: Fold a paper slip and write one because statement for a pretend page: ____________________.

cards.title: Clue Label Direct Result
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable cause-and-effect card for finding the direct effect of an invented clue label move in a paper museum nook: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, stack three blank label shapes, and remind the writer that every clue is invented: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Name the one effect that happens right after the clue label changes places: ____________________.
cards.causePrompt: Cause: The tower guide moves the blue clue label beside ____________________.
cards.effectPrompt: Effect: The direct result is that the next label now shows ____________________.
cards.becausePrompt: Because the blue clue label moved, the paper exhibit points to ____________________.
cards.soPrompt: So the reader can tell that the first clue directly caused ____________________.
cards.chainPrompt: Chain: label moves, clue points, direct effect appears as ____________________.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Look back: Did you choose the effect that happens right after the label move: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Draw one arrow from the cause label to the direct effect label: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-away line: Use two paper scraps to show a cause and its direct effect: ____________________.

cards.title: Compass Craft Choice Cause
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable cause-and-effect card for showing how a character choice causes a compass craft result: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, place a blank cover shape under the lamp glow, and draw a small paper compass dial: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Choose what the compass maker decides, then explain what that choice causes next: ____________________.
cards.causePrompt: Cause: The compass maker chooses ____________________ for the center mark.
cards.effectPrompt: Effect: That choice makes the paper compass point toward ____________________.
cards.becausePrompt: Because the character picked that center mark, the compass craft now ____________________.
cards.soPrompt: So the academy page changes by adding ____________________.
cards.chainPrompt: Chain: character choice, compass shift, new story result: ____________________.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Look back: Can the effect happen only because of the character choice you wrote: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Draw the compass choice first, then write the caused result: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-away line: Make a tiny paper compass and name one choice that causes a result: ____________________.

cards.title: Binding Day Paper Chain
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable cause-and-effect card for linking several invented boardwalk page events into one cause-and-effect chain: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, fold three pretend pages, and place them in a small paper stack near the cushion corner: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write each cause and effect so one result becomes the next cause in the chain: ____________________.
cards.causePrompt: Cause: On Binding Day, the first loose page slides beside ____________________.
cards.effectPrompt: Effect: The paper helper notices ____________________ and changes the page order.
cards.becausePrompt: Because the page order changes, the blank cover shape now needs ____________________.
cards.soPrompt: So the next boardwalk step is ____________________.
cards.chainPrompt: Chain: loose page, changed order, cover fix, final page result: ____________________.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Look back: Does each effect become the reason for the next step in your chain: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Use arrows between four short phrases instead of full sentences: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-away line: Stack three scrap pages and write a cause-and-effect chain for them: ____________________.
